prompt: Write 5 short claim log entries by an auto insurance adjuster for a side impact at intersection claim. Injury: shoulder injury. The claimant is represented by a lawyer. Start each entry on a new line with 'Entry 1:', 'Entry 2:' and so on. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1281; do not mention it.)
text:
Entry 1: Claim opened for a side impact collision at a signalized intersection. Insured vehicle was struck on the driver side by a third-party vehicle entering on a cross street. Police report requested. Initial liability appears to favor our insured based on the scene description, pending witness statements.

Entry 2: Claimant reports shoulder pain following the collision and has since retained counsel. All further communication to be directed to claimant's attorney. Medical authorization forms sent to counsel's office. Recorded statement from claimant deferred per attorney instruction.

Entry 3: Received photos of both vehicles from the insured and the third-party driver. Damage to the insured vehicle concentrated on the driver-side door and quarter panel. Independent appraiser assigned to estimate repair cost. Rental coverage confirmed for the insured.

Entry 4: Spoke with claimant's counsel regarding the status of medical records. Counsel indicates treatment includes evaluation for a shoulder injury and a follow-up scheduled with an orthopedic provider. Records requested. Counsel requested that no direct contact be made with the claimant.

Entry 5: Reviewed the police report and signal timing data. Third-party driver cited for failure to yield on a left turn. Liability assessment updated to reflect primary fault on the third party. Bodily injury evaluation remains open pending receipt of complete medical records and a demand package from counsel.
